summary: SBM Offshore is global group of companies selling systems and services to the offshore oil and gas industry, founded in 1965. Type: listed company. About 6,200 employees (Wikidata). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 5 jobs here don't ask for Dutch. News, last 3 months: 1 about funding; 2 about growth or hiring.

insights.one_liner: Dutch builder and operator of floating offshore oil and gas facilities; IND sponsor with English-language roles around Rotterdam and Amsterdam.

culture.text: More than 7,800 'SBMers' worldwide, with many staff from Brazilian universities plus TU Delft, mostly in mechanical, electrical and chemical engineering.
Describes an inclusive, multicultural culture with digital training and a RISE Leadership Programme; teams also work from India and Malaysia.
Says its international team delivers 2% of the world's oil.

open.text: SBM Offshore Amsterdam B.V. is an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: Is competing with Hanwha Ocean for the Venus FPSO contract in Namibia, where the investment decision has slipped to 2027.

worth_knowing.text: Its work focuses on offshore oil production while also pitching floating wind and other energy-transition projects.
